messageHandlers.script:
try:
		tipId = self.view.params.tipId
		showTips = self.session.custom.get('showTips', True)
		dismissedStr = self.session.custom.get('dismissedTips', '')
		dismissed = [t.strip() for t in str(dismissedStr).split(',') if t.strip()] if dismissedStr else []
		visible = showTips and (tipId not in dismissed)
		self.props.visible = visible
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'TipBadge', 'message': 'tips-refresh: ' + tipId + ' visible=' + str(visible) + ' (showTips=' + str(showTips) + ', dismissed=' + dismissedStr + ')'}, scope='session')
	except Exception as e:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'TipBadge', 'message': 'tips-refresh ERROR: ' + str(e)}, scope='session')
